fixture_contract.protocol: Load clock-48h JSON from the actual candidate_pilot.ROOT and clone it; shorten only pilot.end to 2019-10-09T00:00:00Z.
fixture_contract.sampling_limit_reasoning: At most two eligible users occur, below actual cap 2000. The test retains cap > 2 and does not change the cap, add a cap=2 comparison, or test hash ordering.
fixture_contract.deduplication_hypothesis: For a fixed time/type/user/product event, replacing five optional metadata values with NULL preserves Q and C. This is the same M comparison as V1, not a new duplicate-input experiment.
fixture_contract.N: One view by user 7 at t-1h, product NULL; five metadata fields populated. Q=(7,1,1,0,1,t-1h,1.0,NULL); C empty.
fixture_contract.P: One view by user 7/product 101 at t-1h; five metadata fields populated. Q=(7,1,1,1,1,t-1h,1.0,NULL); C=(7,101,false,true,0,NULL,1,t-1h).
fixture_contract.NP: N plus one purchase by user 8/product 202 at t-2h. Q users 7/8 have eligibility=1/history rows=1/distinct products=0/1. C=(7,202,true,false,1,1,NULL,NULL),(8,202,true,true,1,1,1,t-2h).
fixture_contract.M: Before is a fresh P copy; after preserves event_time,event_type,user_id,product_id and sets exactly category_id,category_code,brand,price,user_session to NULL. Q/C match before and P exactly.
fixture_contract.physical_schema: Every history inserts parse_row values into full literal ordered typed9, asserts DESCRIBE and row count, and explicitly reads back N product NULL and five M metadata NULLs.
fixture_contract.maturity_premise: Assert create_queries leaves label_is_mature NULL; explicitly assign TRUE solely to call the existing candidate validator. No create_labels or Y.
fixture_contract.coverage_premise: Q diagnostic 1.0 is calendar overlap from declared source bounds, not independent archive completeness.
